decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly generate mana through ritual spells and Ruby Medallion to cast powerful spells such as Ral, Monsoon Mage and Past in Flames. The deck aims to efficiently dig through the deck with cards like Reckless Impulse and Wrenn's Resolve to find combo pieces like Hex Magic and Wish to win the game. With the ability to cast multiple spells in a turn and generate a large amount of mana, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its explosive combo potential.

The main concept of this UrzaTron Control deck is to assemble the Urza lands (Urza's Tower, Mine, and Power Plant) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. The deck focuses on disrupting opponents with cards like Trinisphere and Sowing Mycospawn while controlling the board with Karn, the Great Creator, Ugin, the Eye of the Storms, and Sire of Seven Deaths. By utilizing powerful Eldrazi creatures and removal spells like Dismember and Kozilek's Command, the deck aims to dominate the game and overwhelm the opponent with its resources and threats.

The deck focuses on combining instant reanimation and card advantage to quickly bring powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier back from the graveyard. By utilizing cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate, the deck aims to cheat big threats into play early in the game while also disrupting the opponent with counter spells and hand disruption. The deck also utilizes a variety of removal spells to control the board and protect its combo pieces. The strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruptive spells before they can fully set up their own game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to generate as much mana as possible through cards like Ruby Medallion and Pyretic Ritual to cast a combination of spells quickly, eventually leading to a win condition such as Grapeshot. Ral, Monsoon Mage can help filter cards and deal damage, while Past in Flames allows for the reuse of key spells from the graveyard. The deck also utilizes cards like Wish and Valakut Awakening for additional versatility and card advantage. Overall, the goal is to assemble the combo pieces efficiently and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful burst of spells.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using cards like Basking Broodscale and Emrakul, the Promised End to control the game and overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes various cards to ramp up mana, search for key pieces, and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By carefully sequencing plays and maximizing the synergy between cards, the deck aims to create a dominant board presence and close out the game quickly. The combination of creatures, spells, and lands in the deck work together to create a cohesive strategy that can be difficult for opponents to counter.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with a mix of countermagic, hand disruption, and removal spells. The deck aims to control the field by efficiently dealing with threats using cards like Fatal Push and Counterspell, while also disrupting the opponent's plans with Thoughtseize and Force of Negation. The inclusion of powerful finishers like Lórien Revealed and Murktide Regent ensures that the deck can close out the game once it has gained control. By utilizing a combination of control elements and threats, this deck can outclass and outmaneuver its opponents in a 1 vs 1 Modern setting.

The deck focuses on using a combination of self-mill and discard spells to fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures, then bringing them back into play through reanimation spells like Unearth and Persist. The key strategy is to cheat out big threats like Archon of Cruelty and Emperor of Bones early in the game, overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the opponent's board and protect the combo pieces. The main win condition is to beat down the opponent with the reanimated creatures and close out the game quickly.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart, while also leveraging prowess triggers from Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler. Mishra's Bauble and Preordain provide card selection and help keep the pressure up, with Slickshot Show-Off and Cori-Steel Cutter adding additional threats. The deck also includes some countermagic in Spell Snare, as well as pump spells like Mutagenic Growth to further enhance its aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on ramping into powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End using Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga. It utilizes cards like Basking Broodscale and Malevolent Rumble to control the board while setting up its combo pieces. Blade of the Bloodchief and Sowing Mycospawn help to generate tokens and pump creatures, creating a threatening board presence. The deck also includes cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Ugin's Labyrinth to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures.

The deck focuses on using various artifacts and spells to control the opponent's deck and hand, ultimately locking them out of playing their cards effectively. By utilizing cards like Lantern of Insight, Codex Shredder, and Ensnaring Bridge, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy and prevent them from mounting a strong offense. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek allows the player to further control the game and dictate the pace. With a mix of artifacts and spells designed to disrupt and control, the deck aims to outmaneuver and outlast the opponent.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's resources and board state with removal spells like Path to Exile and Cleansing Wildfire, while also ramping towards late-game threats like Avengers Disassembled and Price of Freedom. The deck also utilizes land destruction with cards like Field of Ruin and Demolition Field to slow down the opponent's mana development. Additionally, it has a companion in Kaheera, the Orphanguard, to provide additional synergy and support. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through a combination of control elements and powerful finishers.

Utilize the UrzaTron lands to ramp up mana quickly and play powerful colorless threats like Karn, the Great Creator, Emrakul, the Promised End, and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. Use cards like Kozilek's Command and Dress Down to control the board and disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with big threats and powerful control elements, ultimately winning through sheer card advantage and strong board presence. This archetype excels in making efficient use of mana resources and outlasting opponents in longer games.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on playing low-cost, aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Slickshot Show-Off to quickly pressure the opponent. The deck also includes burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to clear the way for your creatures and deal direct damage to the opponent. The goal is to quickly build a board presence and maintain pressure throughout the game, using cards like Mutagenic Growth and Mishra's Bauble for extra value. Overall, this deck aims to win the game quickly through aggressive creature attacks and burn spells.

The deck revolves around quickly milling the opponent's library by using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Fractured Sanity. It disrupts the opponent's strategy by using cards like Archive Trap and Surgical Extraction. It also has control elements to delay the opponent's game plan, like Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with mill effects, eventually putting them at a disadvantage and winning the game by forcing them to draw from an empty library or by depleting their resources.

The deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creature plays and blinking effects to disrupt opponent's strategies. It seeks to control the board through removal spells like Fatal Push and Solitude, while also utilizing cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate to repeatedly trigger powerful abilities of creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Witch Enchanter. Thoughtseize is used to disrupt opponent's hands, while Teferi, Time Raveler provides additional control. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a mix of fast aggression and disruptive tactics.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures with blink effects to maintain board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By constantly blinking creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Overlord of the Balemurk, the deck can generate value and pressure the opponent. Alongside disruptive spells like Fatal Push and Thoughseize, as well as powerful cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Solitude, the deck aims to control the game while applying pressure. The combination of aggro and blink elements creates a fast-paced and adaptable strategy that can overwhelm opponents.
